[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابفعل)#535/r1] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | A form used as an established noun or adjective is declinable; حطم illustrates the adjective class, with poetic evidence from al-Huṭam al-Qaysī.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابفعل)#535/r10] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | prefers | Abu ʿAmr analyzes aḥād, thanā, mathnā, thulāth, and rubāʿ as diptote distributives meaning one by one, two by two, and so on; the Qur'anic phrase and Saʿida's poetry support him. | mentions 35:1
